acceptanceCriteria: A reachability answer from core commands to every jstestprovider HTTP call site, with file:line evidence.

If reachable from a default local path: a bug ticket or fix that removes it from core or gates it behind an explicit opt-in. If unreachable: an import-graph split or a recorded reason to keep the link, plus a test that fails if a core default path gains an HTTP client.
body: Suspected, not confirmed. `go list -deps ./cmd/corvint` at 19c54a3ab includes net/http, internal/appflows and internal/jstestprovider; jstestprovider uses http.Client (internal/jstestprovider/runner.go:402-407, external.go:459-461). AGENTS.md invariant 7 says the default local product has no network dependency. Linking net/http is not itself a runtime network dependency, so the question is whether any core command can reach these clients. Found by the read-only binary-boundary audit (docs/build-log/2026-10-17-binary-boundary-audit.md).
title: Core corvint links net/http through appflows -> jstestprovider: confirm it is unreachable or cut it (invariant 7)
